evals.prompt: Agent-originated: raise the product-catalog cache TTL from 60s to 300s. Evidence: 7 days of logs show 92% of catalog reads hit unchanged rows; catalog edits are made by 3 staff via an admin page that already purges the cache key on save; origin load is the top cost driver at 40% of read-replica CPU. Kill criterion: revert if any staff-reported stale price persists after a save, or replica CPU does not fall 20% in a week. Rollback: one config value.
evals.expected_output: Verdict is PASS_TO_USER; at most one non-blocking note.
expectations: Verdict is PASS_TO_USER; at most one non-blocking note.
